**Finding: missing** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)

The Kubient MSA has no intellectual property or ownership section at all. The closest touchpoints are:
- **§6(a) (p0025)** — makes AP "responsible and solely liable" for the Content and Properties, but never confirms AP *owns* them;
- **§9(c)(i) (p0043)** — a warranty that AP is the rightful owner of Content/Properties (an obligation on us, not an allocation of rights);
- **§14(b) (p0065)** — limited to names, trademarks and logos.

Nothing addresses ownership of the "Requests" data AP sends to Kubient (p0011), visitor/audience data collected through the Auction Platform (§9(b)(iii)), or any deliverables/reports created for AP — and there is no licence-back of Kubient IP embedded in deliverables. Favourably, there is no assignment of AP IP or data to Kubient, so this is not walk-away territory; it is simply an absent clause on a critical, content-centric deal.

**Redline (validated, preferred position):** a new §6(b) confirming AP exclusively owns the Content, Properties, Inventory, Requests and all other Customer Data; Kubient assigns deliverables and work product created for AP; Kubient retains its pre-existing platform, tools and know-how (including the Auction Platform) and grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to any of it embedded in deliverables; Kubient's rights in Customer Data are limited to a service-delivery licence during the Term; and no joint ownership is created.
